official_definition: Super Unleash: 4 [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks) Destroy any opposing Spirits up to a total of 15000 BP. Also, by putting four cores from your Red/Purple Grandwalker Nexus(es) to this Spirit, send up to two opposing Lives to the Void.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Super Unleash] or [Super Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Super Unleash]", "give [Super Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
